text: The label must show the unique device identifier in plain text and in machine readable form such as a barcode.
Devices supplied sterile must carry a symbol indicating sterile status and the method of sterilization used.
The expiration date must appear in a consistent format and be accompanied by a symbol or text indicating use by.
Storage conditions such as temperature limits must be stated on the label when they affect device performance.
Prescription devices must bear a statement that sale is restricted to or on the order of a licensed practitioner.
The label must state the name and address of the manufacturer responsible for the device.
Lot or batch number must be printed so the product can be traced after distribution.
Single use devices must be marked do not reuse with the corresponding symbol.
Warnings and precautions must be conspicuous and legible and refer to the instructions for use.
Symbols used on labels should conform to a recognised standard and be explained in the instructions for use.
Medicinal products must list active substances and strength on the outer packaging.
Packaging changes must be reviewed so that all affected labels are updated before release.
